name: How long does a typical drywall installation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical drywall installation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard single-room drywall installation usually takes three to five days from hanging boards to final sanding. While fastening the sheetrock often takes just one day, taping and mudding require multiple thin coats, each needing adequate drying time between applications. Complex layouts, tall ceilings, or cold weather can lengthen drying times for joint compound. Working with a coordinated team like HH Remodeling helps prevent delays because the same crew manages framing, drywalling, and subsequent interior painting under one schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most single-room drywall projects take three to five days because joint compound requires dedicated drying time between multiple coats.
